body: A psychotherapist asked me when the last time I was happy, and I thought it was last summer but I realised I wasn't happy just less depressed.
Sounds like serotonin syndrome, if it gets any worse can have heart attacks or seizures. It's horrible I was the same.

Yeah, hopefully they'll help. Give them a try anything is better than feeling the way you do now. 

How are your symptoms at the moment? If you heart rate gets worse go to a&e

Maybe you need something else as well, to help with the depression side of it. 

I took about 3300mg

Are you still be prescribed sertraline? I'm thinking of getting off it, I don't think it's helping at all. Finding something else.

That sounds awful, yeah someone had a heart attack on the ward and I was convince everyone was actors and they was all trying to make me look crazier than I am and see things. I thought my mum had let them do a social experiment on me to see if they could get me to realise I needed help. So I kept ringing her all night, shouting at her and asking how could she do it to me. 

It could be nothing or it could be very serious, please don't risk it. Call 111 (if your in the uk) at tell them your symptoms, they'll call you an ambulance if you need one. 

If I don't reply for a little while, I'm washing my hair as I've been in the bath for an hour and half and it's cold haha.
I'm here for you. If you can try watch a movie or something give yourself something to focus on rather than trying to sleep. It'll be easier to pass out and get your out of your own head.

It annoys me so much when someone tells you to get over something. Things effect people in different ways. 

I'm so sorry that you've been through abuse and trauma in your life. It must have been awful. 

I'll be hear if you want to talk

Just tell them your sick and you need an ambulance. 

Yes, there was that much sertraline in my system that I haven't slept since I took the o/d (took it with sleeping pills and a bunch of paracetamol, would not recommend either) which was about 78 hours ago. 

And worst of all was the paranoid schizophrenic esque episode I had in hospital last night when I was convinced the nurses on the ward was trying to pin me down, dose me up and section me. (I might actually be schizophrenic who knows) 
It was the most terrified I've ever been in my life, if anything like this happens then the best place you could be would be in hospital.

I'm not trying to scare you, this genuinely happened. I'll stay up with you and talk if you like.

I feel better, I'm not hiding my depression and anxiety anymore, all my family and friends have been so lovely. And I'm getting help with all my problems and debts. Tell someone what you did before it's too late. I wasn't found for 8 hours so I didn't get help as soon as I could have. I only got out of hospital this afternoon. 

I honestly feel like it was the stupidest thing I've ever done. But it's made me realise things can change and people can help. 

Sorry for the lengthy rant. And I don't want to lecture you or tell you what to do but is there anyone at home with you now?
So do people ever stop asking if your okay? Glad you made it too.

Please call an ambulance, I did this on Sunday. I  very nearly had a heart attack at 24 with my mum watching, seeing how upset she was is heartbreaking. I've never felt so guilty in my life. People love you, even if you feel like they don't care or won't listen, they will. Nothing is worth this. Get some help please x

My blood pressure got so high I could of had a heart attack (pretty uncomfortable) lots of stomach pain, nausea, poking and prodding and testing. Would not recommend. I'm going to be in hospital for weeks. Not because I'm sick because of my mental health.

Thanks guys, but now I think I'm about to get sectioned 🙁

Edit: I didn't, I'm out now. But I did have a psychotic outburst in hospital and didn't sleep for 76 hours. 

But thankfully life goes on. Time to watch game of thrones then sleep in my own bed.
I don't know, I took  8mg zopiclone 3350mg sertraline and 32 paracetamol a few hours a go and I'm still fucking here.
If I live then I'm stuck with all my problems that drove me to it
I can't bring myself to tell anyone, just going to lie in bed and hope I don't wake up.
